workItems.title: TotemWorkspace bounded execution hardening
workItems.objective: Make TotemWorkspace plan, execute, checkpoint, and resume small verifiable development tasks without overloading model context or losing cross-session progress.

targetRepositories.purpose: Own planning, runtime execution constraints, durable work state, and developer-facing progress surfaces.

tasks.title: Micro-task planning contract
tasks.goal: Define one-primary-concept task boundaries, split triggers, focused validation, checkpoints, and stop boundaries in orchestration plans.
doneCriteria: orchestration plans expose the micro-task policy
validation covers required micro-task contract fields
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not add runtime enforcement in this task.

tasks.title: Work registry foundation
tasks.goal: Persist current objective, repository scope, full task plan, progress, blockers, and checkpoints in TotemWorkspace.
doneCriteria: data/work-registry.json stores the active initiative and decomposed plan
registry structure is validated in CI
current task and per-task progress are machine-readable
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not automatically mutate registry state from the runtime yet.

tasks.title: Runtime micro-task enforcement
tasks.goal: Require the runtime developer instructions to execute at most one planned micro-task at a time and stop at its boundary.
doneCriteria: runtime instructions consume the micro-task contract
runtime cannot silently roll into the next planned task
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not add context truncation handling or progress UI.

tasks.title: Context escalation guardrails
tasks.goal: Enforce narrow-first source and diff retrieval and stop/requery when tool output is truncated or exceeds context budget.
doneCriteria: runtime guidance follows symbol-to-workspace escalation
truncated output is treated as a failed retrieval that must be narrowed
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not add automatic checkpoint persistence.

tasks.title: Automatic checkpoint persistence
tasks.goal: Update durable work progress after each micro-task while keeping transient runtime/replay details local.
doneCriteria: micro-task completion updates canonical task progress
local runtime checkpoint stores branch, head, files, validation, risks, and exact next task
resume starts from the latest checkpoint instead of rescanning the whole workspace
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not build viewer controls in this task.

tasks.title: Work progress surface
tasks.goal: Expose active objective, target repositories, plan, current task, blockers, and completion state through supported Workspace surfaces.
doneCriteria: supported clients can read the active work summary
plan state is visually distinct from actual runtime activity
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not expand the architecture graph contract beyond progress visibility.

checkpoint.summary: TotemWorkspace bounded-execution hardening is fully implemented and validated across TWX-01 through TWX-06.

checkpoint.validation: PR #53 Validate TotemWorkspace, Validate Code-first Inventory, and Validate Flutter Viewer all passed. Earlier stacked PR validations also passed.

workItems.title: TotemAlchemy M6 EffectDose and concentration
workItems.objective: Continue the TotemAlchemy 26.3 chemistry rewrite using the repository roadmap as the authoritative full plan, completing M6 as bounded independently verifiable micro-tasks before dependent M7 station-output work.

planSource.note: Authoritative full rewrite plan; this registry item tracks the currently active M6 milestone only.

targetRepositories.purpose: Implement EffectDose quantity, standard dose, concentration, presentation split, conservation and regression coverage.

tasks.title: Canonical EffectDose quantity
doneCriteria: EffectDose exposes canonical quantity
duration/amplifier conversion is explicit
focused GameTest adds no new regression
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not define standard-dose lookup or concentration.

tasks.title: Standard dose lookup
tasks.goal: Define standard dose lookup from registered one-bottle potion contents.
doneCriteria: registered potion contents remain source of truth
lookup returns canonical EffectDose per effect
focused normal/strong/effectless cases pass without new regression
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not derive concentration or change Brewing Stand output.

tasks.title: Effect concentration
tasks.goal: Derive effect concentration from EffectDose and liquid volume.
doneCriteria: concentration has one explicit formula
standard one-bottle dose maps to baseline concentration
focused tests cover volume scaling
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not implement potency/duration presentation split.

tasks.title: Sustained potency-duration split
doneCriteria: sustained effect output derives potency and duration from concentration
EffectDose quantity remains conserved

tasks.title: Configurable split bias
tasks.goal: Add configurable potency-duration bias with default 0.5.
doneCriteria: bias is configurable
default is 0.5
focused tests cover the default

tasks.title: Instant-effect concentration
doneCriteria: instant effects use an explicit concentration rule
sustained-effect behavior remains unchanged
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not expand into dilution or merge regression work.

tasks.title: Dilution conservation
doneCriteria: dilution changes concentration without creating or destroying EffectDose
focused regression passes
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not alter merge/extract semantics beyond what the test exposes.

tasks.title: Merge and extract conservation
doneCriteria: split plus remainder conserves EffectDose
merge restores conserved total
focused regression passes

tasks.title: Normal recipe concentration cap
tasks.goal: Add concentration cap behavior for normal recipes.
doneCriteria: normal recipe cap is explicit
cap does not violate EffectDose accounting
focused cap tests pass
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not perform the full M6 regression pass.

tasks.title: EffectDose regression pass
tasks.goal: Run the bounded EffectDose regression pass.
doneCriteria: M6 focused tests pass
no new regressions beyond documented inherited failures
M7-T08 prerequisites are explicit
tasks.stopBoundary: Do not begin M7-T08 in the same task.
